# Knowledge map: Native USB debugger, monitor and diagnostic storage

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/native-debugger.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Native root USB debugger, native volumes and file API, the existing monitor transport, SD diagnostic journal attempts, debugger v2 and the WinUSB control transport.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 32 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | PC Remote switching during diagnostic sessions | The camera self-rebooted twice around PC Remote transitions during the journal attempt. | Isolate mode transitions before staging collectors; keep each session bounded and verify /proc/uptime continuity afterwards. | [E0236](../evidence/0236-physical-journal-path-and-reboot-fault.md), [E0244](../evidence/0244-p0-idle-isolation-trial-1.md), [E0245](../evidence/0245-p0-idle-isolation-trials-1-3.md) |
| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | Internal flash volume B: | Writes to /dev/nflasha23 could damage firmware state. | B: (/dev/nflasha23) is excluded from every write; do not infer volumes from drive letters. | [E0222](../evidence/0222-physical-sd-volume-device-association.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="tool-native-debugger"></a>Native root USB debugger (A6400_USB_DEBUG)

`tool.native-debugger` | tool

Root daemon on the camera reached over normal USB external commands (feature 0x23), used by tools/camera_debugger.py for read-only probes, process memory and bounded exec.

Aliases: `camera_debugger.py`, `feature 0x23`, `a6400-lived`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `PHYSICAL` The native root USB debugger validated on hardware over normal USB external commands without Senser/updater entry: A6400_USB_DEBUG_V1, uid/euid/gid 0, feature 0x23. ([E0090](../evidence/0090-native-usb-debugger-contract-and-prepared-upgrade.md), [E0092](../evidence/0092-native-root-usb-debugger-hardware-validation-and-touch-state.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` The first approved debugger bootstrap stopped on an original-driver mismatch before the later validated deployment. ([E0091](../evidence/0091-approved-debugger-bootstrap-original-driver-mismatch.md))

### <a id="tool-debugger-v2"></a>USB debugger v2 and WinUSB control transport

`tool.debugger-v2` | tool

In-band dmesg/warm-ring readout, process-context recover and an always-on WinUSB control channel (Phase A daemon, B1c bounded 18-byte patch).

Current knowledge:

- **C08** `PHYSICAL` Debugger v2 reads dmesg and the warm ring in band, recovers in process context and measured the mode-switch boundary; the always-on WinUSB Phase A daemon and the B1c bounded 18-byte patch were verified in Mass Storage only. ([E0400](../evidence/0400-usb-debugger-and-runtime-probe-infra.md), [E0401](../evidence/0401-usb-debugger-v2-ring-recover-and-mode-boundary.md), [E0402](../evidence/0402-always-on-winusb-debugger-feasibility-and-phase-a.md), [E0403](../evidence/0403-winusb-control-transport-msc-verification.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` In Mass Storage the gadgetcore gate blocks the MS OS 2.0 WinUSB path; the dynamic device-descriptor builder and an MS OS 2.0 function subset were decoded offline. ([E0404](../evidence/0404-b1b-mode-gate-and-b2-b3-blockers.md), [E0405](../evidence/0405-option-a-offline-preflight.md), [E0405](../evidence/0405ab-device-desc-builder-and-msos2-subset.md))
- **C10** `PHYSICAL` Three-target RAM save/restore was verified in Mass Storage without re-enumeration. ([E0407](../evidence/0407a-three-target-save-restore.md))

### <a id="proc-native-volumes"></a>Native file API, volumes and IFSYS

`proc.native-volumes` | process

Sony native volume table and file API: A: is the SD card (/dev/mmca), B: is internal flash (/dev/nflasha23, excluded).

Aliases: `A:/dev/mmca`, `B:/dev/nflasha23`, `Fsys_Open`

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `PHYSICAL` Native file API contracts and the live volume table were read; A: maps to the physical SD (/dev/mmca) and B: to internal flash (/dev/nflasha23). ([E0220](../evidence/0220-native-filesystem-contracts-and-live-volume-table.md), [E0221](../evidence/0221-physical-native-volumes-in-pcremote.md), [E0222](../evidence/0222-physical-sd-volume-device-association.md))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` An ordinary MSC -> PC Remote -> MSC session answered the fixed IFSYS SD information query. ([E0232](../evidence/0232-corrected-ordinary-sd-query-session.md), [E0234](../evidence/0234-ordinary-pcremote-ifsys-query-answered.md))

### <a id="proc-monitor-transport"></a>Existing monitor transport and SD diagnostic journal

`proc.monitor-transport` | process

Sony's existing monitor ring (libMWF) used read-only for output capture and help round trips, plus the bounded SD-journal collector attempts.

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` The existing monitor transport and ring contract were decoded; read-only output capture, preserved-output acknowledgement and a native monitor help round trip work on the camera. ([E0224](../evidence/0224-existing-monitor-transport-and-ring-contract.md), [E0225](../evidence/0225-physical-readonly-monitor-output-capture.md), [E0226](../evidence/0226-preserved-monitor-output-acknowledgement.md), [E0227](../evidence/0227-physical-native-monitor-help-roundtrip.md))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` An ordinary MSC -> PC Remote -> MSC session answered the fixed IFSYS SD information query. ([E0232](../evidence/0232-corrected-ordinary-sd-query-session.md), [E0234](../evidence/0234-ordinary-pcremote-ifsys-query-answered.md))
- **C06** `PHYSICAL` The physical SD-journal attempt created no file: Fsys_Open failed with 0x80000041 (CreatePathInfo), and the camera self-rebooted twice around PC Remote transitions. Offline execution showed an 8.3 path rejection, not an empty letter table. ([E0236](../evidence/0236-physical-journal-path-and-reboot-fault.md), [E0237](../evidence/0237-offline-path-contract-8.3-rejection.md), [E0238](../evidence/0238-8.3-journal-rebuild-offline.md))
- **C07** `PHYSICAL` A read-only MSC log harvest found no retained session logs. ([E0259](../evidence/0259-msc-log-harvest.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Persistent diagnostic authorization and storage preflight were recorded; the authorized SD diagnostic journal still requires verified service ownership, non-overwrite creation, bounded write, flush/readback and restart survival. ([E0219](../evidence/0219-sd-journal-authorization-and-storage-preflight.md), [E0223](../evidence/0223-journal-service-entry-and-creation-boundaries.md))
- **C12** `OFFLINE` The native monitor collector, a bounded passive on-camera collector, the preserve-before-ack fixed SD query and the prefix acknowledgement were built and checked offline; the bounded SD-journal collector was built offline before the physical attempt. ([E0228](../evidence/0228-native-monitor-collector-preparation.md), [E0229](../evidence/0229-bounded-passive-monitor-collector.md), [E0230](../evidence/0230-fixed-sd-query-and-preserve-before-ack.md), [E0233](../evidence/0233-preserved-output-prefix-acknowledgement.md), [E0235](../evidence/0235-bounded-sd-journal-collector-build.md))
- **C13** `PHYSICAL` One query session was not published; the receipt was complete and cleanup verified. ([E0231](../evidence/0231-query-not-published-and-native-output-boundary.md))
